entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mrs. G. P. Mulekar, App for Respondent No.1-State.

Coram : A.S. Gadkari And
 Prakash D. Naik, Jj.
Issue notice to Respondent No.2 returnable on 18th April, 2023.

Mr. Deshpande, learned Advocate for Petitioner submitted that, perusal of FIR indicates that,
admittedly after one year of marriage, Respondent No.2 was staying separately with her husband.

That, even if all the contents in the FIR are taken at its face value, then also it is difficult to discern that an offence under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code is made out against Petitioners.
3. In view thereof, ad-interim relief, in terms of prayer clause "b" qua the Petitioners.

(PRAKASH D. NAIK, J.) (A.S. GADKARI, J.)
